name: Pricing
instructions: Tell me when the price of any plan changes, or when a plan is added or removed. Ignore the "last updated" time.

name: Pricing: Pro gets cheaper
instructions: Tell me only when the Pro plan gets cheaper. Price rises and other plans do not matter.

name: Volatile page
instructions: Tell me about real changes to the content. Ignore clocks, counters, view counts and anything else that is different on every visit.

name: List additions
instructions: Tell me when an item is added to the list. Items that only move do not matter.

name: Shifted layout
instructions: Tell me when the page looks different: a banner appears, or an image or a button changes.
